title: dryopteris renchangiana
intro: Dryopteris renchangiana, commonly known as the Chinese shield fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of fern that is native to the mountainous regions of China. The Chinese shield fern is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing antioxidant and anti-inflammatory health benefits that can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties.
